back: Devon Glover, our creative partner at Sonnet Man, has spent years proving that Shakespeare is hip-hop. He's both a teaching artist and stage actor. His work blends poetry, adaptation and contemporary music. He's worked with the Southern Shakespeare Festival, Shakespeare Behind Bars, and schools across the United States.

text: Мы создаём платформу цифровых развлечений, которая соединяет коллекционные карты с возможностями ИИ. Наша цель в том, чтобы люди общались друг с другом и получали удовольствие от технологий, которые укрепляют человеческие связи, а не заменяют их.

back: This is the Inspired Mile: a platform where digital collectible cards are linked to AI and augmented reality, giving birth to a new kind of interactive entertainment.

text: Наш творческий партнёр Devon Glover, он же Sonnet Man, много лет доказывает, что Шекспир — это хип-хоп. Он артист, педагог и театральный исполнитель, а в его работах соединяются поэзия, адаптация и современная музыка. Он сотрудничал с фестивалем Southern Shakespeare Festival, с программой Shakespeare Behind Bars и со школами по всем США. Мы переносим эту энергию в цифровую среду.
english: Our creative partner Devon Glover, the Sonnet Man, has spent years proving that Shakespeare is hip-hop. A teaching artist and theater performer, his work fuses poetry, adaptation, and contemporary music. He's partnered with the Southern Shakespeare Festival, Shakespeare Behind Bars, and schools nationwide. We're taking that energy digital.
back: Our creative partner Devon Glover, aka Sonnet Man, has been proving that Shakespeare is hip-hop for years. He’s an artist, educator and theatre performer whose work blends poetry, adaptation and contemporary music. He’s collaborated with the Southern Shakespeare Festival, the Shakespeare Behind Bars program and schools across the U.S. We’re bringing this energy to the digital world.

english: Shakespeare gives us a rich universe of houses, characters, and conflicts: a natural foundation for a trading card battle system. And it's all public domain.
back: Shakespeare gives us a rich universe of houses, characters and conflicts: the natural basis for a system of battles on collectible cards. And all this is in the public domain.

text: Kami membangun platform hiburan digital yang memadukan kartu koleksi dengan pengalaman bertenaga AI. Misi kami adalah membuat orang saling berinteraksi dan bersenang-senang dengan teknologi yang memperkuat hubungan antarmanusia, bukan menggantikannya.

text: Itulah Inspired Mile: platform tempat kartu koleksi digital terhubung dengan pengalaman AI dan realitas tertambah, dan melahirkan jenis hiburan interaktif yang baru.

text: Mitra kreatif kami, Devon Glover, yang dikenal sebagai Sonnet Man, telah bertahun-tahun membuktikan bahwa Shakespeare adalah hip hop. Ia seniman pengajar dan pemain teater, dan karyanya memadukan puisi, adaptasi, dan musik masa kini. Ia pernah bekerja sama dengan Southern Shakespeare Festival, Shakespeare Behind Bars, dan sekolah-sekolah di seluruh Amerika Serikat. Kami membawa energi itu ke dunia digital.
english: Our creative partner Devon Glover, the Sonnet Man, has spent years proving that Shakespeare is hip-hop. A teaching artist and theater performer, his work fuses poetry, adaptation, and contemporary music. He's partnered with the Southern Shakespeare Festival, Shakespeare Behind Bars, and schools nationwide. We're taking that energy digital.
back: Our creative partner, Devon Glover, known as the Sonnet Man, has been proving for years that Shakespeare is hip hop. He's an educational artist and theatre actor, and his work blends poetry, adaptation, and contemporary music. He's worked with the Southern Shakespeare Festival, Shakespeare Behind Bars, and schools across the United States. We're bringing that energy to the digital world.

back: Shakespeare gave us a rich universe of dynasties, characters and conflicts: the natural basis for a system of collectible card battles, all in the public domain.

back: Platform architecture, AI systems and fundraising strategies with a background in spatial computing and digital experience.

back: Bringing Shakespeare to life through hip hop, poetry and adaptation. The educator artist, playwright, and voice behind Shakespeare on the Go. Music available on Spotify, Tidal, and Apple Music.
